name: Dynamic Tomographic Reconstruction with Motion Identification (DynTomo)
aliases: Dynamic Tomographic Reconstruction with Displacement Field Identification
definition: A staggered two-step iterative process that alternates between reconstructing a volume from a frozen displacement field and identifying the motion from a frozen estimate of the microstructure to handle deforming volumes in tomography.
summary: DynTomo is a staggered iterative method that reconstructs deforming 3D volumes from time-series projections while simultaneously identifying the full space-time displacement field to correct motion artifacts.
